### Headline summary
- Active exploitation of the Java4Shell vulnerability and critical RCE flaws in Apache Roller and Perforce Puppet poses an immediate threat to enterprise systems. ([Cisco Talos Blog](https://blog.talosintelligence.com/java4shell/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/java4shell/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/hackers-exploiting-critical-puppet-rce.html), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203377/hacking/u-s-cisa-adds-perforce-puppet-enterprise-flaw-to-its-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog.html))
- A supply-chain compromise of the Microsoft Agent Framework on PyPI is being used to steal Azure and GitHub credentials. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/microsofts-agent-framework-pypi-package/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/attackers-compromise-microsofts-agent.html))
- Russian state-backed APTs are leveraging stolen cloud data to impersonate employees and breach US organizations. ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/russian-cold-relic-hackers-use-stolen.html), [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/russian-star-blizzard-cloud-data/))

### Java4Shell vulnerability enables unauthenticated remote code execution
Multiple reports detail the Java4Shell vulnerability, which allows unauthenticated remote code execution and affects OpenJDK and enterprise applications. ([Cisco Talos Blog](https://blog.talosintelligence.com/java4shell/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/java4shell/), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/java4shell-vulnerability-puts-many-enterprise-applications-at-risk-of-takeover/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/cisa-urges-immediate-patching-of.html))

### Apache Roller and Perforce Puppet RCE flaws exploited
Hackers are actively exploiting critical remote code execution flaws in Apache Roller and Perforce Puppet, affecting enterprise management servers. ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/hackers-exploiting-critical-puppet-rce.html), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203377/hacking/u-s-cisa-adds-perforce-puppet-enterprise-flaw-to-its-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog.html), [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/apache-warns-of-roller-rce-vulnerability-exploited-in-attacks/), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/critical-perforce-puppet-rce-exploited-in-attacks/))

### Microsoft Agent Framework PyPI package compromised
Hackers published malicious versions of Microsoft's agent-framework package on PyPI to steal Azure, GitHub, and CI credentials. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/microsofts-agent-framework-pypi-package/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/attackers-compromise-microsofts-agent.html), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/microsoft-agent-framework-releases-poisoned-with-credential-stealer/), [CSO Online](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4250156/attackers-hijack-microsofts-agent-framework-package-to-steal-azure-and-ci-credentials.html))

### Russian APTs exploit stolen cloud data for breaches
Russian state-backed groups, including Star Blizzard and Cold Relic, are using data stolen from cloud accounts to impersonate trusted employees and breach US organizations. ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/russian-cold-relic-hackers-use-stolen.html), [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/russian-star-blizzard-cloud-data/), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/russian-apt-poses-as-employee-of-hacked-firm-to-breach-another-us-organization/), [The Record](https://therecord.media/russia-cyber-espionage-google))

### NGINX HTTP/2 vulnerabilities allow remote code execution
Two critical vulnerabilities in NGINX's HTTP/2 implementation, including CVE-2026-123633 and CVE-2026-123007, allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on web servers. ([wiz.io](https://www.wiz.io/blog/nginx-http2-rce-vulnerabilities), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/nginx-http-2-vulnerabilities/), [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/five-critical-vulnerabilities/))

### Optimizely breach used to inject malware into websites
A breach of the Optimizely platform is being used to inject malware into websites, exposing major web properties to security risks. ([CSO Online](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4249925/optimizely-confirms-massive-cyberattack-on-customer-websites-injected-stealer-malware.html), [Krebs on Security](https://krebsonsecurity.com/2026/11/attackers-used-optimizely-to-a-b-test-malware-on-top-websites/), [ZATAZ](https://www.zataz.com/optimizely-pirate-des-geants-du-web-exposes/), [Detect.fyi](https://detect.fyi/kqls-for-major-brands-compromised-through-optimizely-86fdaf055707?source=rss----d5fd8f494f6a---4))

### Oracle patches 950 vulnerabilities in November 2026 update
Oracle released its November 2026 Critical Security Patch Update, addressing 950 vulnerabilities including over 300 unauthenticated, remotely exploitable flaws. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/oracle-patches-640-vulnerabilities-with-november-2026-cspu/), [Qualys Blog](https://blog.qualys.com/category/vulnerabilities-threat-research))

### New attack bypasses Windows Hello and BitLocker PIN lockout
Researchers demonstrated a new attack that bypasses TPM lockout protections on AMD and some Intel PCs, allowing Windows Hello and BitLocker PINs to be cracked in days rather than years. ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/flash-chip-attack-bypasses-tpm-lockout.html), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/hello-attack-bypasses-windows-hello-and-bitlocker/))
